scope: Uncommitted working tree including the earlier Codex implementation and Claude fixes; no commit or deployment performed.
environment: Production Next build, its actual cookie-authenticated proxy, disposable FastAPI fixture store; no production records changed.

preservation.branding: Existing college logo, chocolate/gold palette and assets reused.
preservation.forms: No data-entry field definitions, order, validation or payload definitions changed by this audit. Earlier uncommitted New Enquiry edits retained.
preservation.database: No migrations or production record writes performed by this audit. Existing schema-file changes were present before the audit.
preservation.authorization: Existing current_user, has_permission, screen allowlists and resource actions retained.
preservation.navigation: All 93 existing workspace screens accounted for. Duplicate Admissions setup card hidden; legacy URL redirects, and a secondary records link preserves every existing admission register.

fixed_findings.finding: Monthly trends were rendered as donut charts when another chart preceded them
fixed_findings.resolution: Trend/month charts always use bars; added a real-stack chart regression assertion; payment method labels are human-readable.
Use the selected batch roster sections for enrollments, student metrics, program chart, attendance and student-linked pending records. Regression tests include another batch.

fixed_findings.finding: Students by program used a nonexistent section.program_code
fixed_findings.resolution: Verified and retained Claude fix: section → batch → program.
Verified and retained Claude roster-based membership fix; expanded dependent counts and leave scoping.

fixed_findings.finding: Attendance duplication and unclear missing values
fixed_findings.resolution: One Student attendance metric; selected-student/year/date scope; explicit Not marked text and explanation when no attendance exists.

fixed_findings.finding: Unique admission registers became unreachable after duplicate-card removal
fixed_findings.resolution: One primary Admissions card plus More admission records. The legacy setup route keeps a query mode for all existing registers, with document registers first.
Use row names/titles and authorized related student/employee/vendor names; retain codes when access is absent.
Wrap actions within workspace width; responsive evidence covers all 13 enabled hubs at eight widths.
Build charge/allocation indexes once per request and reuse the original balance calculation; exact result-parity and bounded-scan tests.

fixed_findings.finding: Academic dashboards built the full semester and fee workspace unnecessarily
fixed_findings.resolution: Use a published-result summary path with parity tests; retain the full semester endpoint contract.

fixed_findings.finding: Sidebar label size depended on stylesheet order
fixed_findings.resolution: 15px, bold labels in the module-navigation stylesheet itself.

fixed_findings.finding: Old browser fixtures expected retired controls, old cookie duration, missing course-level selection and malformed widget responses
fixed_findings.resolution: Updated fixtures and assertions to the existing UI/contracts without changing production forms or auth.

fixed_findings.finding: Certificate test tried issuing through local storage although issuance requires S3
fixed_findings.resolution: Assert missing-S3 rejection, then use an in-memory S3 adapter to verify issuance, signature, download audit and tamper detection.

test_results.browser_stack_note: The full suite skips the five explicitly enabled real-stack tests. Their separate run uses EDUNEXA_AUDIT_BASE_URL. No request mocks are used in that run.
test_results.workflow_coverage_note: Existing backend workflows and browser form suites were rerun. Deep-link traversal proves rendering/access, not an exhaustive manual CRUD/approval/export exercise for every production role and every record type.

performance.environment: Disposable local fixture backend and production Next build; not production latency

remaining_external_validation: SQL Server integration is opt-in and was skipped; no production schema or records were changed to force it to run.
Production latency must be measured after deploying the backend changes; local fixture timings cannot be compared directly with the reported Mac-to-production timings.
Real S3 delivery, external SMS/email/payment providers, and manual acceptance using every actual production role/account remain environment-specific checks.
Transport remains hidden according to the existing frontend configuration; its backend hub and permission checks were tested.
No deployment, commit or merge performed.
